description: Public Ed25519 keys that verify firmware manifests (docs/protocols/003-firmware-manifest.md). Standard padded base64 of the raw 32-byte key. Build-time setting of the firmware, the integration and the installer: a fork replaces them with its own (docs/releasing.md). `current` signs releases (key id 7a622ae0a78916f7), `next` (key id 3a352ded7eab9eb8) is kept offline for rotation.
